name: Admin Local Tasks
description: Overrides core local-task (tabs) styling to a fixed style.
project_description:
This module make Drupal (Admin) Local Task links fancier and more accessible for content editors on non-admin routes (front pages) - with minimalistic design and fixed position on left or right side.

 Installation 
 
 Enable Admin Local Tasks module 
 Make sure you have Primary Tabs block enabled 
 
 Related Modules 
 Better Local Tasks 

This module source code was used as initial point when start working on own version.
